run_experiment_with_algo_and_task: run a BenchMarkRL Experiment with a given algorithm config and PettingZoo task
test_all_algos_with_pettingzoo: test all registered algorithm configs against PettingZoo tasks with continuous and discrete action modes
test_gnn_model_config: run an Experiment using a GNN model config with IppoConfig, QmixConfig, or IsacConfig on SIMPLE_TAG
test_gru_with_parallel_collection: run an Experiment with a GRU model config and toggle parallel collection for data gathering
test_reload_trainer: test reloading a saved trainer checkpoint using ExperimentUtils.check_experiment_loading across multiple algorithms
